$Classic Controller and GameCube controller
*By quatric
*SpongeBob SquarePants: Creature from the Krusty Krab (Europe) (RQ4P78)
*Play with a Classic Controller or a GameCube controller: either one is presented to the game as a Wii Remote and Nunchuk.
*Hold L+R+Start on a GameCube controller for the HOME menu.
* after KPADRead: Classic Controller samples become Nunchuk samples, a GameCube pad writes its own
